name: 34120 · Naples, FL
findings: ZIP 34120 (Naples) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34120 (Naples) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34120 (Naples) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).
